scope: Offline review of the fixed strategy-routing runtime and production worker boundary, using temporary ledgers, synthetic model/embedding replies, an in-memory HTTP opener and the real pinned source graph and official query engines. No execution was started.

user_authorization.note: The review verifies implementation against the recorded authorization; it does not supply new budget authorization.

resolved_findings.resolution: The worker uses an independent exact embedding validator, not the probe.validate_payload reference that it replaces. Actual worker behavior is now exercised with a synthetic HTTP opener.

HTTP401/402/403 normalize to fatal authorization reasons even without a recognized body category. Credential/account/security/global-budget/integrity/uncertain-dispatch failures stop the run. Transport gate Halts propagate fatally, and readiness is checked before reservation.

Resume reconstructs cumulative and per-cell input counters from exact request files/events, verifies event sequence/body/key/index and refuses mismatches. The independently reproduced counter-reset case is covered by the regression test.

Completed response hashes are bound in the new ledger and verified on resume. A worker invoked again after its response already exists returns without overwriting it. A valid completed reply left before supervisor acknowledgement is recovered without sending another request.

Readiness requires a fixed implementation file set instead of accepting an empty hash map. A separate new input manifest binds526 old read-only files; frozen protocol files and old paid ledger remain unchanged.

DRIFT Local model-visible context now uses the shared source/provenance CSV renderer and whole-row4000-token prefix. The original upstream context is retained separately. Ranking, official query engine, frozen routing and gold are unchanged.

Execution segments are retained, completed segment durations are summed, and interrupted unknown-duration segments are counted explicitly. Repeated identical assembled evidence has a stable key and read_occurrences rather than duplicate rows.

verified_execution_properties.routes: One frozen routed GraphRAG method over23 unique queries, compared with BM25/Basic/hybrid; no result-based route switch.
verified_execution_properties.transport: Only the existing fixed Responses and OpenAI embedding endpoints are available through the reviewed probe helper. No redirect, SDK fallback or hidden retry is introduced. Generation worker120seconds and embedding worker30seconds; outer supervisor adds2seconds. No overall wall deadline.
verified_execution_properties.serialization: Shared runtime lock spans wait, reservation, transport and response handling; process-level active.lock excludes a second controller. The worker also claims each dispatch slot exclusively.
verified_execution_properties.retry: At most two extra authorized transient attempts per exact service/body; timeout, connection interruptions,429 and5xx share the allowance and5/15-second minimum backoff with Retry-After. Unknown usage is never converted to zero.
verified_execution_properties.replay: Successful request bodies/schemas reuse exact cached replies. Each question has fresh QueryState; deterministic template and pending-action selection make whole-query replay stable.
verified_execution_properties.failures: A cell budget or complete-response content failure remains an explicit failed cell without route switching. Account/security/global budget/integrity failures stop the entire run.
verified_execution_properties.source_isolation: The completed graph and imported embeddings are only read. New reservations, responses, cache indices and answers use a distinct run directory. No index pipeline is launched.
verified_execution_properties.execution_sessions: Each create/resume records actual git HEAD, reviewed implementation hashes, Python version, process hash seed and prior counters before entering the query loop.
verified_execution_properties.dispatch_markers: Transport records the local worker dispatch_started marker in request_dispatched; explicit false prevents retry while retaining the conservative budget reservation.

disclosures_and_followup_validation: These are offline software and boundary tests, not real endpoint compatibility tests, retrieval-quality results or answer-accuracy evidence.

The adapter requests JSON/schema modes and rejects duplicate fields and schema failures more strictly than the upstream permissive JSON repair path. This behavior and any resulting failed cells must be disclosed; no paid regeneration is used to repair a complete reply.

The adapter accepts upstream temperature0/top_p1/n1 defaults but uses the fixed provider payload with temperature omitted, as its decision log records. Do not describe transmitted sampling arguments as identical to every upstream default.
DRIFT Local provenance rendering and4000-token whole-row clipping are explicit context serialization adaptations; save both the actual model-visible context and upstream context.

Assembled context is not automatically model-exposed evidence. Global records all four prepared map chunks before all dispatches; Local context can be assembled before a budget failure. Derive actual exposure and raw-source unions from the corresponding real request events and saved input, and label uncertain dispatch separately.
Request/response logs cover HyDE and primer as well as Local/reduce; final upstream context_data alone is not the full evidence footprint.

Execution segments with unknown interrupted duration must remain unknown; the sum of known segments is not a complete end-to-end latency when such segments exist. Recovery waiting time and replay occurrences must be identified.

The1883 cap has no allowance for hidden probes or new administrative reservations. Per-cell64k may stop execution before all nominal stages/retries; such failures remain in the frozen scoring denominator.
Provider output can exceed requested2048; actual usage and overruns must be retained, and missing usage remains unknown. The embedding estimate is not total model cost.
No new real answers have been reviewed. Final scoring,92-cell completeness, cohort denominators, exposure accounting, public export redaction and conclusion checks remain later work.

request_dispatched:true records a local dispatch-start marker written immediately before opener.open; it does not prove remote receipt or successful processing. Unknown outcomes and marker-to-network crash windows remain conservative reservations/attempts, not confirmed provider usage.
